title: BuildingConnected Pro → Forma Bid
subtitle: Unofficial feature availability tracker
introduction:
This page tracks the availability of BuildingConnected Pro functionality inside Forma Bid. The majority of project-level functionality is available today, with several improvements. Your existing BuildingConnected data is the same data in Forma — both products can be used simultaneously, and all of your BuildingConnected data is accessible within Forma. Features marked "Improved" or "New" represent capabilities that go beyond what was available in BuildingConnected Pro.
Note: the term "RFP" is used in place of "BuildingConnected Project" to separate bidding efforts from the Forma project.

tables.title: Project-Based Functionality
tables.description: Forma Bid has almost all project-based functionality available, with several improvements over BuildingConnected Pro.

features.name: Creating & managing RFPs (BuildingConnected projects)
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: Managing multiple RFPs per project
features.notes: Now you can manage multiple pricing efforts (RFPs) within a single Forma Project, instead of having to rely on multiple disconnected BuildingConnected projects.

features.name: Importing RFPs from templates
features.notes: All data from BuildingConnected available; improvements to import flow include the ability to import bid packages with either/or bidders instead of always importing both.

features.name: Creating and managing bid packages
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: Network profiles
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: Sending bid invites and managing bidders
features.notes: Same overall search functionality plus the ability to use natural language search when adding a specific bidder.

features.name: Document sharing
features.notes: It's now easier to select multiple bid packages when choosing a folder to share with bidders.

features.name: Messaging
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected; new ability to filter across messages. Forma Bid does not use Build's Correspondence feature.

features.name: Creating bid forms
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected; new ability to add item codes to more line items.

features.name: Viewing, submitting, and printing bids
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: TradeTapp Qualification Card
features.notes: Significantly more TradeTapp data availability, including flags.

features.name: Bid levelling
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected, with ongoing investment to expand capabilities.

features.name: Reports
features.notes: Radical expansion of reporting by leveraging Forma Reports to provide custom filters and field selection for all existing BuildingConnected reports.

features.name: Sending TradeTapp qualification invites
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: Sealed Bidding Support
features.notes: Same as BuildingConnected.

features.name: Creating contracts in Cost Management
features.notes: New ability to link contracts and their SOVs to multiple budgets.

features.name: Bid Board Integration
features.notes: The integration still works, but there is no interface for viewing the connected opportunity from Forma.

features.name: Indirect Project Costs
features.notes: Not on the roadmap. Forma Estimate is recommended as an alternative.

tables.title: Account & Company Functionality
tables.description: Forma Bid uses the same network as BuildingConnected. While the data is available for consumption, native management of that data within Forma Bid is still in development.

features.name: Network Suggested Edits
features.notes: You can see suggested edit information in the profile view, but not yet directly in the UI. For example, a changed phone number will display in the profile, but not yet on bidders list.

features.name: Profile Management
features.notes: Native profile management within Forma Bid is coming. BuildingConnected remains available for this functionality in the meantime.

features.name: Builder's Network Employee Management
features.notes: Research is underway. You can continue to use BuildingConnected for this functionality.

features.name: Builder's Network Office Management
features.notes: Research is underway. You can continue to use BuildingConnected for this functionality.

tables.title: Cross-Project Functionality
tables.description: The below functionality remains available inside BuildingConnected. These capabilities are planned for Forma, though they may look different than their BuildingConnected equivalents.

features.name: Global Network Search
features.notes: This refers to the free-form search field in the top navigation in BuildingConnected. Network search is available within the bidder invite flow in Forma Bid.

features.name: Managing templates
features.notes: Planned for Forma. The experience may differ from BuildingConnected.

features.name: Contacts
features.notes: Planned for Forma. The experience may differ from BuildingConnected.

features.name: Bid History
features.notes: Planned for Forma. The experience may differ from BuildingConnected.

features.name: Analytics
features.notes: Planned for Forma. The experience may differ from BuildingConnected.
